:::{#exm-norm-sum-square}
#### Checking the expansion

For $\vecf{x} = (3, 0)$ and $\vecf{y} = (1, 4)$:
$\vecf{x} + \vecf{y} = (4, 4)$, so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\norm{\vecf{x} + \vecf{y}}^2 &= 16 + 16 \\
&= 32,
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\norm{\vecf{x}}^2 + 2\,(\vecf{x} \cdot \vecf{y}) + \norm{\vecf{y}}^2 &= 9 + 2 \cd 3 + 17 \\
&= 32.
\end{aligned}
$$

For the orthogonal vectors $(3, 0)$ and $(0, 4)$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\norm{(3, 4)}^2 &= 25 \\
&= 9 + 16,
\end{aligned}
$$

the $3$-$4$-$5$ right triangle.

:::
